name: Fire Tongs
description: Jim's fire tongs, from beside the stove. Long. For coals. And, today, a sash.

name: Grand Currency
//: Story Phase 14: the Grand Currency is its own counter (story variable grand_currency_tokens), never gold. It buys nothing anywhere.
description: GRAND STENCHMASTER GRAND TOKENS OF GRAND CURRENCY: {num:grand_currency_tokens}. Cheap plastic. NOT LEGAL TENDER, on every one. Squawks says: bad money.

variants.description: {num:grand_currency_tokens} Grand Tokens. NOT LEGAL TENDER. The only branch has concluded business. What they're for, says Brogath: being wealthy.

name: Teller's Badge
description: CAPTAIN STINKBEARD. ACTING GRAND TELLER OF GRAND ATMOSPHERIC ASSETS. YOUR GAS IS OUR BUSINESS! Brass, nearly. The pin is bent. A souvenir of a bank that no longer exists.

name: Holiday Branch
description: A tiny Christmas ornament shaped like the Grand Bank. HOLIDAY BRANCH: NO TELLER REQUIRED! It holds no money, can't be entered and performs no banking.

variants.description: The HOLIDAY BRANCH (NO TELLER REQUIRED!), on loan to Garrick's Grand Crown. He says it completes the regalia. It performs no banking.
